mapper.sql: select id, trace_id, scene, capability, provider_code, channel_id, model_id, attempt, input_tokens, output_tokens, image_count, elapsed_ms, first_token_ms, status, error_code, request_digest, operator, create_time from ai_call_log
mapper.insert: insert into ai_call_log ( trace_id, scene, capability, provider_code, channel_id, model_id, attempt, input_tokens, output_tokens, image_count, elapsed_ms, first_token_ms, status, error_code, request_digest, operator, create_time ) values ( #{traceId}, #{scene}, #{capability}, #{providerCode}, #{channelId}, #{modelId}, #{attempt}, #{inputTokens}, #{outputTokens}, #{imageCount}, #{elapsedMs}, #{firstTokenMs}, #{status}, #{errorCode}, #{requestDigest}, #{operator}, sysdate() )
mapper.select: select id from ai_call_log where create_time < #{before} order by id limit #{limit}
mapper.delete: delete from ai_call_log where id in #{id}
mapper.select:
select
date_format(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as groupKey,
cast(model_id as char) as groupKey,
scene as groupKey,
count(1) as totalCount, sum(case when status = 'SUCCESS' then 1 else 0 end) as successCount, sum(case when status = 'FAILED' then 1 else 0 end) as failedCount, ifnull(sum(input_tokens), 0) as inputTokens, ifnull(sum(output_tokens), 0) as outputTokens, ifnull(sum(image_count), 0) as imageCount, ifnull(round(avg(elapsed_ms)), 0) as avgElapsedMs from ai_call_log
AND create_time >= #{beginTime}
AND create_time < #{endTime}
AND scene = #{scene}
group by groupKey
order by groupKey asc
order by totalCount desc, groupKey asc
